decision.reason: The market shows stable demand and a slight increase in premium mix. Candidate 898a2b58efaf52 (recent_value) is selected as it offers a balanced approach to high-value discovery across all merchants, aligning with the current stable inventory and return levels. It was chosen over the pooled support models, which showed consistently negative expected values in the development profiles.
